framing.title: An integrated 8-week approach across Technology Productivity and AI-enabled Reimagination
framing.subtitle: Two tracks, one fact base: how productive technology is today, and where AI can reshape how the work gets done

columns.objective_lead: Establish the productivity of every technology dollar spent today,
columns.objective_rest: where to cut or rebalance investment to fund the future, and where capabilities stand relative to best in class, producing a holistic set of growth, effectiveness, and efficiency levers rather than a cost exercise alone.
approach: launch data requests, confirm stakeholders and logistics, finalize surveys, and frame initial hypotheses on where value sits
establish spend across applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and labor, then benchmark cost, productivity, delivery maturity, and engineering maturity
deep dives into infrastructure, vendor contracts, developer productivity, and tech debt, pressure tested in 5-10 leadership interviews
shape go-forward initiatives with estimated savings, owners, and implementation implications, and sequence them into a high-level roadmap
assets: : cost and risk of accumulated tech debt
outputs: Technology spend and productivity baseline, benchmarked against peer and cross-industry sets
Quantified savings opportunities by area, with the actions required to capture each
Prioritized initiatives with estimated savings, owners, and implementation implications
Leadership-aligned high-level roadmap with sequencing and dependencies

columns.objective_lead: Identify where AI creates the greatest business value across domains,
columns.objective_rest: then reimagine the highest-value workflows around people working alongside AI, moving from value at stake sized across the confirmed domains to two reimagined domains with blueprints and a roadmap.
approach: inventory the full set of business domains (e.g., Personal Investor, Personal Wealth) and collect data on headcount, cost, volume, decision points, and hand-offs
Weeks 1-2, baseline and size initial value at stake:
confirm the domains where material value is at stake, baseline each on process flow, personnel, and performance, and size an initial view by domain
validate the value at stake with business, technology, finance, and corporate functions leaders, then rank domains on value, readiness, and feasibility to select two
Weeks 5-8, reimagine the two priority domains:
design each future-state journey and the roles of people and AI agents, and set out the talent, operating model, data, technology, and control implications
assets: : bottom-up sizing of AI impact by domain
: end-to-end visibility into how work flows today, as the base for the redesign
: AI and AI-agent workflow designs already proven by domain
outputs: AI value at stake sized across the confirmed set of domains, with a scorecard that ranks them
Future-state workflow blueprints for the two priority domains, including AI and human roles
Talent, operating model, data, technology, and control implications
High-level roadmap across the two priority domains, with sequencing and dependencies

framing.closingLine: Both tracks run over the same 8 weeks against one fact base and a single steering committee, closing in a joint week 8 session that sets out where the value sits and the sequence to capture it
